fact: Statistics Mauritius issued its Strategy for Official Statistics 2020-2025, a five-year strategy with four strategic objectives, for the official statistical system (Statistics Mauritius, Bank of Mauritius, Ministry of Health and Wellness); the document is dated March 2021 and states no separate adoption date.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): Strategy for Official Statistics 2020-2025.
